test_captured_output: test that pybind11 captured_output writes a message to stdout and nothing to stderr
test_ostream_redirect: test the ostream_redirect context manager to capture C++ stdout into a Python StringIO
test_captured_err: test that pybind11 captured_err writes a message to stderr and nothing to stdout
test_captured_dual: test that pybind11 captured_dual writes separate messages to both stdout and stderr
test_threading: test that pybind11 ostream_redirect is safe across 20 concurrent C++ threads
